Thank You!
After ten intense and fulfilling years at Schlossberg, saying goodbye does not come easily for Ximena and Herbert. With passion, dedication, and great attention to detail, they have had the privilege of bringing this special place to life—welcoming, hosting, and caring for their guests.
Countless encounters, conversations, and shared moments will remain in their memories and forever hold a place in their hearts.
From the bottom of their hearts, Ximena and Herbert thank all their guests for their loyalty, trust, and kind words throughout the years.
With deep gratitude and a touch of bittersweet emotion, they say farewell—and wish Schlossberg and its guests many more unforgettable moments to come.

Boutique Hotel
Boutique Hotel Schlossberg - a calm and comfortable oasis. The former prison wing features 14 modern, tastefully furnished double rooms and one family room, all with a gorgeous view of the courtyard and the keep. Both the exclusive tower room and the generously-spaced panorama room offer a magnificent view of Lake Thun and the Alps. A small, well-kept spa area completes the facilities. Perfect calm and glorious views – experience the ultimate in relaxation and enjoyment.
